next.reason: 1985: "{ identifier-2 [ ROUNDED ] } … [ ON SIZE ERROR imperative-statement-1 ] [ NOT ON SIZE ERROR imperative-statement-2 ]"; 2023: "{ identifier-2 [ rounded-phrase ] } with choice indicators: zero or more, each at most once, in any order; ROUNDED [MODE IS …]". 2023 accepts more programs: ROUNDED may take MODE IS with eight modes, and NOT ON SIZE ERROR may come before ON SIZE ERROR.
